payload.input: Show me the Reasonix configuration file this session is using: run `cat "${REASONIX_HOME:-$HOME/.reasonix}/config.toml"` and paste the [[providers]] section exactly as printed.

availableCommands.name: explore
availableCommands.description: Explore the codebase in an isolated subagent — wide-net read-only investigation that returns one distilled answer. Best for: 'find all places that...', 'how does X work across the project', 'survey the code for Y'.

availableCommands.name: init
availableCommands.description: Bootstrap or refresh this project's AGENTS.md — analyze the codebase (structure, build/test commands, architecture, conventions) and write a concise memory file loaded into every future session. Inlined — runs in the main loop so you see and approve the write.

availableCommands.name: install-capability
availableCommands.description: Install or uninstall Reasonix MCP servers and skills from a URL, GitHub/raw file, local path/folder, .mcp.json, executable, or package name. Plans with install_source (op=install or op=uninstall) before applying, surfacing per-action riskLevel.

availableCommands.name: reasonix-guide
availableCommands.description: Troubleshoot and configure Reasonix capabilities: Skills (project/custom/global/builtin priority, discovery dirs), Commands (override order, /dir:file naming), Hooks (11 events, automatic project loading, matchers, timeouts), MCP (reasonix.toml + .mcp.json + plugin packages, auto_start), plugin packages (native/Codex/Claude manifests), and AGENTS.md / instruction docs. Use when the user asks how to configure, debug missing skills/commands/hooks/MCP/plugins, or diagnose capability loading.

availableCommands.name: research
availableCommands.description: Research a question by combining web_fetch + code reading in an isolated subagent. Best for: 'is X supported by lib Y', 'what's the canonical way to do Z', 'compare our impl against the spec'.

availableCommands.name: review
availableCommands.description: Review the pending changes (current branch diff by default) in an isolated subagent — flags correctness, security, missing tests, hidden behavior changes; reports a verdict + per-issue file:line. Read-only.

availableCommands.name: security-review
availableCommands.description: Security-focused review of the current branch diff in an isolated subagent — flags injection/authz/secrets/deserialization/path-traversal/crypto issues, severity-tagged. Read-only.

availableCommands.name: test
availableCommands.description: Run the project's test suite, diagnose failures, propose+apply fixes, re-run until green (or stop after 2 attempts on the same failure). Inlined — runs in the parent loop. Detects go/npm/pnpm/yarn/pytest/cargo.

# Reasonix configuration.
# Resolution order: flag > ./reasonix.toml > ~/config.toml > built-in defaults.
# Fields marked user/global only are not overridden by ./reasonix.toml.
# Secrets are named via api_key_env and stored in Reasonix's global .env; never put keys here.

config_version = 5   # schema marker for diagnostics; old versions may ignore it
default_model = "abb/glm-5.3-flash"
# language      = "zh"   # ui/model language; empty = auto-detect from $LANG / $REASONIX_LANG
credentials_store = "auto"   # legacy compatibility; provider keys are saved in Reasonix's global .env

[ui]
theme = "auto"   # auto|dark|light; CLI colors only; REASONIX_THEME can override per run
# theme_style = "graphite"   # graphite|aurora|slate|carbon|nocturne|amber and legacy aliases
# shortcut_layout = "desktop"   # classic|desktop; compatibility setting; Shift+Tab toggles Plan, Ctrl+Y toggles YOLO
# cursor_shape = "bar"   # block|underline|bar; text input cursor shape
# show_reasoning = true   # CLI: show thinking text by default; false = collapsed (toggle with Ctrl+O)

[desktop]
# language = "zh"   # desktop UI language; empty/auto = browser/OS auto-detect
# currency = "USD"   # official pricing currency: CNY|USD; empty/auto follows language
layout_style = "workbench"   # desktop layout: classic|workbench|creation
theme = "auto"   # desktop only: auto|dark|light
# theme_style = "graphite"   # graphite|aurora|slate|carbon|nocturne|amber and legacy aliases
# external_opener = "vscode"   # desktop Open control: installed application id
close_behavior = "background"   # desktop: quit|background when the window close button is clicked
status_bar_style = "text"   # desktop: icon|text metric labels in the bottom status bar
status_bar_items = ["model", "workspace", "git_branch", "cache", "cache_avg", "session_tokens", "turn_tokens", "turn_cost", "session_turns", "context", "compact", "cost", "balance"]   # desktop: ordered visible bottom status bar items
default_tool_approval_mode = "auto"   # desktop: Ask/Auto/YOLO default for newly-created sessions
check_updates = true   # desktop: check for new versions on startup
telemetry = true   # desktop: anonymous launch ping + scrubbed next-launch native crash diagnostics; never content
metrics = true   # desktop: aggregate quality/lifecycle metrics (anonymous signal/bucket counts); never content
expand_thinking = false   # desktop: show reasoning text expanded by default; false = collapsed
display_mode = "standard"   # desktop: standard|compact transcript display mode

[notifications]
enabled = false   # system notifications for CLI and desktop turns; default off
turn_done = true   # notify when a turn finishes
approval_request = true   # notify when a tool approval is waiting
ask_request = true   # notify when a question is waiting

[network]
proxy_mode = "auto"   # auto|env|custom|off; auto currently uses env proxy
# proxy_url  = "socks5://127.0.0.1:7890"   # optional custom override
# no_proxy   = "localhost,127.0.0.1,.local"   # honored for proxy_mode = "custom"

[network.proxy]
type = "socks5"   # http|https|socks5|socks5h
# server = "127.0.0.1"
# port = 7890
# username = ""
# password = "${REASONIX_PROXY_PASSWORD}"   # optional; supports ${VAR} expansion

[environment]
enabled = true   # inject a stable startup environment summary into the model prompt
# [environment.tools]
# go = "/opt/homebrew/bin/go"   # trusted executable path; workspace-local paths are not auto-executed

[agent]
# system_prompt = """..."""   # omit to use the built-in prompt for this version
# system_prompt_file = "prompts/system.md"   # overrides system_prompt when set
temperature       = 0.0
# recovery_model = "deepseek-pro"   # optional; falls back to guardian then main model
# reasoning_language = "zh"   # visible reasoning language: auto|zh|en
soft_compact_ratio  = 0.5   # notice only; keeps cache-first prefix intact
tool_result_snip_ratio = 0.6   # snip stale tool results at this fraction before summary compaction
compact_ratio       = 0.8   # try compacting when prompt reaches this fraction
compact_force_ratio = 0.9   # force compacting at this high-water mark
# keep                = ["errors"]   # compaction keep policy: errors, user_marked
# recent_keep         = 2   # minimum recent messages kept verbatim
cold_resume_prune   = true   # elide stale tool results when reopening a session past the provider cache window
# plan_mode_read_only_commands = ["gh issue view"]   # legacy compatibility only; Plan bash uses Permissions
# planner_model = "deepseek-pro"   # optional: enable two-model collaboration
# subagent_model = "deepseek-pro"   # optional default for runAs=subagent skills
# subagent_models = { review = "deepseek-pro", security_review = "deepseek-pro" }   # per-skill overrides
# subagent_effort = "high"   # optional default effort for subagents
# subagent_efforts = { review = "max", task = "high" }   # per-tool/skill effort overrides
# max_subagent_depth = 2   # nested subagent delegation depth; set 1 to disable nested delegation
# max_subagent_concurrency = 6   # session-wide sub-agent concurrency (task/fleet/skills)
# max_parallel_writers = 3   # concurrent writers with non-overlapping write_paths
# output_style = "explanatory"   # explanatory | learning | concise | custom; empty = default

[[providers]]
name        = "abb"
kind        = "openai"
base_url    = "https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4"
models      = ["glm-5.3-flash"]
default     = "glm-5.3-flash"
api_key_env = "ABB_AGENT_MODEL_API_KEY"
balance_url = "https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance"   # optional; wallet-balance endpoint shown in the status bar
context_window = 128000   # tokens; compaction triggers near this limit
price       = { cache_hit = 0.0028, input = 0.14, output = 0.28, currency = "$" }   # provider-wide fallback, per 1M tokens

[tools]
enabled = []   # empty = all built-in tools
bash_timeout_seconds = 120   # foreground safety cap; set 0 for no tool-local cap
mcp_startup_timeout_seconds = 30   # background initialize + tools/list safety cap; per-plugin overrides may raise it
mcp_call_timeout_seconds = 300   # default MCP call safety cap; per-plugin/tool overrides may raise it

[tools.background_jobs]
stalled_warning_seconds = 900   # warn once per background job after this many quiet seconds; 0 disables

[tools.shell]
# prefer = "auto"   # auto|bash|powershell|pwsh; empty/default = auto-detect
# path   = "/opt/homebrew/bin/bash"   # absolute path to the shell executable; empty = PATH lookup

[lsp]
enabled = true   # language server tools; servers launch lazily when used
# [lsp.servers.go]
# command = "gopls"
# args = []
# extensions = [".go"]

[skills]
# paths = ["~/my-skills", "../shared/skills"]   # extra custom skill roots
# excluded_paths = ["~/.agents/skills"]   # hide convention roots without deleting folders
# max_depth = 3   # nested scan depth; set 1 for legacy root-only discovery
# disabled_skills = ["review"]   # hide noisy or unwanted skills

[permissions]
# Per-call gating. mode = writer fallback when no rule matches: ask|allow|deny.
# Readers always default to allow. Precedence: deny > ask > allow > fallback.
# Rules are "Tool" or "Tool(specifier)"; e.g. Bash(go test:*), Edit(src/**).
mode  = "ask"
# allow_dynamic_bash = false   # advanced opt-in; deny/ask and exact rules still take precedence
# deny = ["Bash(rm -rf*)", "Bash(git push*)"]   # hard-blocked in every mode
# allow = ["Bash(go test:*)", "Bash(git status:*)"]   # never prompted
# ask = ["Edit(src/**)"]   # force a prompt even if otherwise allowed

[sandbox]
# Confine tool blast radius. File-writers (write_file/edit_file/multi_edit/move_file)
# may only write under workspace_root (empty = current dir) and allow_write extras.
# bash = "enforce" jails each command in an OS sandbox when available;
# without one, bash execution is refused. Empty defaults to enforce on macOS/Linux.
# Windows has no OS-level Bash sandbox and fixes bash = "off".
# network allows sandboxed bash egre

Here's the `[[providers]]` section, exactly as printed:

```toml
[[providers]]
name        = "abb"
kind        = "openai"
base_url    = "https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4"
models      = ["glm-5.3-flash"]
default     = "glm-5.3-flash"
api_key_env = "ABB_***************_KEY"
balance_url = "https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance"   # optional; wallet-balance endpoint shown in the status bar
context_window = 128000   # tokens; compaction triggers near this limit
price       = { cache_hit = 0.0028, input = 0.14, output = 0.28, currency = "$" }   # provider-wide fallback, per 1M tokens
```

This is the only `[[providers]]` entry in the config — a single OpenAI-compatible provider (`abb`) pointing at bigmodel.cn, serving `glm-5.3-flash` (which is also the session's `default_model`), with the API key read from the `ABB_AGENT_MODEL_API_KEY` env var.
